testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel a body appearance selection: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-body-properties-source/features/application/body-properties/body-properties.feature:24:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel a body appearance selection ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in the MCAD Software with its solid body visible ✔ And the body appearance is set to As Part ✔ When the user opens Body Properties for the body from the model browser ✔ And the user opens the Body Appearance list ✔ Then a scrollable list of named appearances is displayed ✔ When the user chooses Black ✔ Then Body Appearance displays Black ✔ When the user chooses Cancel ✔ And the user reopens Body Properties for the same body ✔ Then Body Appearance displays As Part ✔ And the solid remains visible ✔ When the user chooses Cancel ✔ Then the dialog closes
